name: Toxic
notes: Venomole's move 3 (R). Fills the 9x9 tiles around the user with toxic gas for 5 s; the cloud stays where it was used. Every monster the gas touches takes 4 damage at once, then 4 more every half second while it stays (each monster has its own timer), and each hit has a 50% chance to badly poison it (1, 2, 3... damage a second for 8 s). The ground never misses. Wild monsters only use it when the player is within 4 tiles; the player's goes off anyway. Charge: 60 s.
title: TOXIC
